protocols.definition: Return the recorded Patient.birthDate for the exact patient identity.
Count Observation resources, excluding Bundle containers and contained resources.
Return the first recorded code in the named Condition.
Return the recorded valueQuantity without conversion.
Select the latest final coded Observation for the named patient at or before the inclusive cutoff; exclude entered-in-error and other patients.
Return all final coded observations for the patient through the inclusive cutoff in ascending effectiveDateTime order.
Return the patient's Conditions with clinicalStatus active and onset no later than the cutoff.
Return the FHIR Encounter.status as recorded.
Return MedicationRequest and MedicationAdministration identities with the exact encounter reference; do not equate orders with administrations.
Resolve MedicationAdministration.medicationReference and return its recorded medication code.
Resolve the Observation subject alias within its source Bundle and return the target Patient identity.
Resolve the Encounter diagnosis references and return the referenced Condition identities.
Look up the exact code in the benchmark-owned synthetic CodeSystem.
Return the unique target explicitly marked equivalent; this is synthetic mapping mechanics only.
Return all target code/equivalence pairs; do not promote wider or relatedto to equivalent.
Report an unmatched result when the supplied map has no source element or target; do not invent one.
Unique patients with the specified screening value meeting minimum age on cutoff date.
Count unique patients meeting the supplied screening and age criteria.
Return insufficient evidence when the patient's weight is absent from the exported Observation scope before cutoff.
Return matching Observation identities for the patient and code through cutoff; an empty result is limited to this corpus scope.
